title: Agent Pay and Verifiable Intent objects
caption: Left: Agent Pay program objects as named in Mastercard developer guides, with no public wire schema. Right: Verifiable Intent credentials and mandates from the open spec (main at 356c296, 2026-04-20). Field names on main differ from tag v0.1.0.
alt: Class diagram. Program objects: SignatureInput with keyid, alg, created, expires, nonce, tag; AgentUserIdentity with mastercardIdToken, signature, kid, nonce, alg; PaymentData with paymentData, signature, kid, nonce, alg; Intent with intentId, intentSummary, intentStatus, orders, consumer, digitalAccountCredentials; Order with orderId, orderExecutionType, orderStatus, orderExpiry, orderTotalAmount, items, merchants; Merchant with srcDpaId. VI objects: L1 credential binds user key; L2 holds checkout and payment mandates; L3a holds a final payment mandate; L3b holds a final checkout mandate; open mandates hold constraints.
